svg.title: Running on the afternoon sun
svg.desc: Dusk scene. A house with twelve 570 W solar panels on a west-facing roof at 15 degrees, about 6.84 kWp, lit by a low sun on the left. DC power runs to a LuxPower hybrid inverter with a battery; the EVN grid feeds in, with no export. Through the bedroom window: an air conditioner and a spinning fan controlled by a Broadlink IR hub. On the circuit-board ground, a Home Assistant chip talks to the hub over Wi-Fi.

g.text: Where the homelab meets the house.
